kind: HELD source/control proposal; non-destructive Android emulator-path sample only
author: /root/ci_workflow
ownership: Only this android-emulator-absence-audit-01 packet. Root retains canonical edits, local build/test lane, cleanup, network/Actions, adoption, staging/commit/push and final conclusions.

historical_execution.scope: Three fresh Android instrumentation PASS and Gradle/claimed-output cleanup accepted. Emulator exit/AVD retirement was not attested; no leak was established.

rationale.adb_limit: The runner later reported an adb termination action, not an explicit wait/exit acknowledgement; this proposal does not inspect platform-tools/adb or retrofit that historical evidence.

change_scope: Only desktop-android preparation gains a binding to the canonical configured ANDROID_HOME path digest, SDK-root device/inode and matching non-root real/effective UID. Optional ANDROID_SDK_ROOT must resolve to the same SDK. The SDK root already exists before the current SDK installation step; the emulator child is validated only at cleanup.

Existing final Gradle stop, successful preparation, exact task/run/attempt/source/output ownership, clean worktree, safe path preflight and successful nonempty uploaded-evidence gates remain intact and precede the audit. Audit FAIL raises before the first rmtree, retaining all currently claimed output paths.

The cleanup receipt nests the current head/tree plus validated SDK/UID binding, counters and fixed error codes. The existing outer receipt binds task/run/attempt/job and upload; existing cleanup-receipt upload is unchanged. No workflow modification or extra dispatch/artifact is proposed.

One read-only non-atomic enumerated /proc sample checks stable PID starttime and four UIDs around selected-UID executable readlink/device/inode observations. Other-UID executable paths are not read. Current observer PID must itself be coherently sampled. Missing, denied, malformed, changed, redirected, oversized, over-budget or live matching observations fail closed.
No process signal, argv/environ read, adb/device command, lifecycle watcher, SDK/AVD/output relocation, process ownership grant, or global cache/device deletion is added.

bounds.qualification: The deadline is checked during enumeration, per PID and at completion. This is a bounded scan budget, not a preemptive kernel-syscall watchdog; no extra process/lifecycle/signal harness is introduced.

proof_limits: PASS means only that no matching executable path was observed among coherently sampled visible selected-UID PIDs beneath the bound canonical SDK/emulator subtree. It is not an atomic or continuous absence certificate.

It does not prove emulator termination, AVD retirement, task ownership of any observed process, absence under another UID/SDK, or copied/redirected executables outside the path predicate. Adb and global emulator/device state remain outside scope.

PID churn or inaccessible metadata can conservatively fail the audit even when an emulator is not running. Such FAIL must retain outputs and be investigated, never auto-retried/relabelled or converted into a leak claim.
Nothing here upgrades the historical4cc cleanup receipt, changes native730a evidence, weakens a release guard, or changes application code, protocol/privacy/authority/timing rules.

actually_executed: AST parsing of both proposed files without import or execution
verification.fixture_scope: Eleven added test methods (nine Linux-only owned proc metadata/symlink fixture methods and two cleanup-integration methods). Thirty-three methods total in this file; Linux-only methods are explicitly skipped on non-Linux hosts. Symlink targets are inert owned fixture files, never real process executables; no actual /proc is sampled by these tests.
verification.test_location_warning: The held copy retains canonical ROOT-relative imports. Do not execute it in place as though it were a standalone tested overlay; root must control adoption/testing against the canonical layout.

independent_review.design_feedback_only: Reviewer agreed the narrow shape is proportionate and required explicit sampled-path predicate/limitations. This is not source approval.

adoption_requirements: Independent source review, root-controlled exact patch adoption and focused actual Linux fixture/guard verification before any source freeze.

Batch with the later final source freeze, regenerate/commit mechanical inventory, and derive fresh source/control bindings; the shared helper also participates in native process-probe controls. Do not modify canonical files during the current730a native execution.
A later justified final Linux Android job must produce its own actual audit/cleanup receipt. Fixture success cannot substitute for that hosted metadata observation or Android application runtime.

cleanup.note: No Gradle, emulator, build/test worker, network operation, canonical edit, stash manipulation or deletion was performed; no build cleanup cycle was started.
